meta.name: card-twitter
meta.description: 推特金句 / 数据卡, 适合配推文

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成推特风格的金句卡片和数据图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常发推特需要配图来吸引眼球
copy.tagline_en: Generate tweet-style quote cards and data charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often tweet and need eye-catching images

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会生成一张 1600×900 的分享卡：中央一句金句，下方作者署名、头像占位和 handle，左上角类型标签，右下角品牌水印，并带 grid 网格或噪点纹理。
howto.when: 当你要做配推文的金句卡或数据卡时，它会按「Twitter 分享卡」模板接管 16:9 卡片的生成，暗色或亮色按内容情绪二选一。

say.text: 把这句话做成推特金句卡：“慢即是快”

say.note: 生成亮色卡片并带署名与 handle

say.text: 左上角标签改成 Data，右下角加我的水印
say.note: 调整类型标签与品牌水印

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates a 1600×900 share card: a hero quote in the center, author signature, avatar placeholder and handle below, a type label top-left, a brand watermark bottom-right, plus grid or noise texture.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a quote or data card to pair with a tweet; it takes over making the 16:9 card from the Twitter Share Card template, dark or light by mood.

say_en.text: Make this into a Twitter quote card: "Slow is smooth"
Use the light version and sign it @myname
say_en.note: Generates a light card with handle

say_en.text: Change the top-left label to Data and add my watermark
say_en.note: Adjusts the type label and watermark
